name: kinetis/database-bridge
description: Kinetis wiring for kinetis/persistence and kinetis/orm: DB_* connection configuration and the default link binding, closed with the application scope, SQL spans through Kinetis telemetry, a lazy request-scoped TransactionGuard whose cleanup is registered once a scope resolves it, and, with kinetis/orm installed, AOT-compiled entity metadata, an ORM factory for every connection an entity names and a lazy request-scoped registry of entity managers.

suggest.kinetis/migrations: Migration runner and migrate commands, connecting through this package's connection policy.
suggest.kinetis/orm: Attributed entities and typed repositories, with entity metadata compiled into the AOT cache: an OrmFactoryRegistry for the worker and a request-scoped EntityManagerRegistry over the default link and every named connection an entity declares, with OrmFactory and EntityManager as the default connection's entries.
suggest.kinetis/query-builder: Parameterized queries and row-to-DTO mapping over the MysqlLink/PostgresLink this package binds.
